text.title: FreshDrop express slots, test 1–14 September 2026
text.question: Does showing 2-hour slots on the home screen raise slot-to-order conversion?
text.hypothesis: Buyers abandon because the slot picker sits two taps deep
text.right_if: Slot-to-order rises from 61% to 70% or more in 2 weeks, in 2 districts with 50% of traffic
text.people: New and returning buyers in Khimki and Mytishchi, about 9,000 sessions
text.materials: Home screen mockup, A/B flag, 40,000 RUB for push messages
text.procedure: 2 weeks, 50/50 split by user ID, 9,000 sessions, checked daily
text.observations: Variant: 70.4% slot-to-order vs control 61.2%; errors 15% vs 27%
text.conclusion: Validated: roll out to all Moscow districts from 1 October
